Real player-side +5 feet, but NOT engine work — RECORD_MARKERS already carries this exact lane (black-powder-boost: on:'action', id:'leap', value:'+10 feet'), and leap/high-jump/long-jump all exist as action ids in core.json.

situational.note: You jump 5 feet farther when you Leap.
A successful High Jump carries you 5 feet farther.
A successful Long Jump carries you 5 feet farther. When calculating falling damage, don't count any distance fallen while you are adjacent to a wall.

Injects deadly d8 onto a strike another record granted; derive.ts reads deadly-dN off the strike's own traits and no field edits an already-granted strike, so re-granting it via grantedStrikes would duplicate the attack. Engine work stands.

Record carries no critSpec; the fix pairs critSpec with critSpecWeapons (34 shipped `bases` precedents, cf. tengu-weapon-familiarity), butterfly-sword is a real item id, and the follow-on knife clause is correctly withheld.

Grants deadly d8 to wielded agile/finesse melee weapons and doubles deadly dice on a crit — both change the printed crit line, and no field injects a weapon trait or alters deadly-dice multiplication.
Unconditional deadly d10 (or an upgrade) on every unarmed Strike; the crit line is computed from strike traits and no legal field adds one.

Self resistance set with a real duration; mode.resistances accepts formula strings and derive.ts substituteTokens resolves @actor.abilities.int.mod, with the identical ally-aura benefit correctly excluded.

Real, but NOT engine work — the app computes no recovery DC anywhere, and RECORD_MARKERS is the shipped surface for exactly this (the-survivor / draddeths-edge / hero-gods-bond all mark on:'condition', id:'dying' with recovery-check text).

situational.note: The DC of your recovery checks is 9 + your dying value, or 8 + your dying value if you have the Toughness general feat. Magic that returns you to life never leaves you debilitated for a week.

rulings.why: Self resistance to all damage; resistance type "all" has shipped precedent (stone-body), and floor((@actor.level+1)/2) is exact because domain focus spells are always auto-heightened to half your level rounded up, so it cannot over-grant.

mode.name: Echolocation

mode.note: Switch this on after you Seek: until the start of your next turn you can use hearing as a precise sense with a range of 40 feet. You can also use this sense while you Search.
